usage: Used for a person who acts in films, TV dramas, stage shows, or commercials. It is a common everyday noun in Hong Kong Cantonese.
Can be used on its own after a classifier when counting people, e.g. with 個 or 位, depending on how polite or neutral you want to sound.
Often appears in job-related talk, entertainment news, and when describing someone’s profession or career.
For a male actor or female actor, 演員 works for both; there is no gender change in the word itself.
